name: Detox My Heart
source:
An adult romance visual novel set at Serenity Summit, a luxury wellness retreat tucked high in the mountains—beautiful, expensive, and suspiciously perfect. Burned-out tech journalist Marcus arrives undercover to write an exposé on the viral "transformation" taking the internet by storm… only to find himself disarmed the moment he hands over his phone at the gate.

As bonfire confessions crack polished facades and the retreat's missing founder casts a long shadow, Marcus is pulled into three intimate, high-stakes romances—each demanding a choice between ambition and authenticity, exposure and protection, truth and love.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4400480/]Steam[/url]]
